faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Discovery SDV8 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the generation. D3 cars (2004–2009) use the TDV8 4.4-litre V8 diesel, while D4 cars (2009–2016) use the SDV8 — a higher-output version of the same 4.4-litre V8 diesel. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Discovery SDV8 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery SDV8?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV8 or the SDV8 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV8 Discovery SDV8 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR components, turbo components and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild SDV8 Discovery SDV8 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The SDV8 shares the same fundamental architecture as the TDV8 and we service it to the same standard, replacing the same components on every rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Discovery SDV8 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Discovery SDV8 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Discovery SDV8 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Discovery SDV8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
